system.description:
The alien stirrings of the Watts-MacLeod virus have left the character convinced that they are something other than transhuman, an alien being trapped in a body of terrestrial origin.

Suggested Game Effects: Very similar to body dysmorphia (p. 212, EP), except that the character’s desire is to emerge as an alien being. The character has difficulty when resleeving (–10 to –30 on Alienation Tests if the morphs is not alien enough) and may seek out exotic body modifications in a quest to become more “alien.”

Source: Eclipse Phase Transhuman, p. 155.
